## The Journey Begins

Welcome to my personal corner of the web. 

For a long time, I have wanted a dedicated platform to document my learning, organize my personal views, and share deep dives into the topics that fascinate me.

Coming from a background in **computational physics**—working with Density Functional Theory (DFT), high-performance computing clusters, and analyzing material structures—I have always been drawn to extracting meaning from data and understanding complex systems.

## What to Expect Here

As I deepen my focus into **Data Science and AI**, I plan to use this space for:

1. **Technical Deep Dives:** Practical explorations of machine learning models, statistical methods, and computational workflows.
2. **Physics & Simulation Insights:** Bridging concepts between physical simulation and modern data-driven approaches.
3. **Personal Perspectives:** Honest reflections on career transitions, continuous learning, and technology trends.

Stay tuned for more articles!
